title: One claims.jsonl row, typed
description: methodology.md's twelve fields (their rules are claims-check.py's L1-L19), plus five typed fields the runner's joins read: question_id, page_id, kind, stage and known. claims-check.py --typed grades the five against the row's state and the reader's hosts.

question_id.description: The questions.json question the row answers; allocation joins rows to slots by it. null on a row written before the questions exist, such as the reader's.

page_id.description: The fetch stem of the page at url, <host>-<sha8>, from pages/index.tsv; null when url is empty or names no fetched page.

kind.description: evidence: a page says it (verified, named) or refused to be read (blocked). absence: a search found nothing (unfound, not named). join: the client's own list read against a rival (named, not named).

stage.description: The node that wrote the row. null only on a backfilled row whose writer is not recorded.

known.description: Set by code, never by an agent: true when the url's host is the reader's company domain or a subdomain of it, or one of reader.known_hosts exactly.
